title: Still There
note_on_ids: Shot ids follow the edit order. v2's s2_sheet and s3_review swapped places, so the review (fetch) is now s2 and the sheet (greet) is s3. On 2026-09-27 s2b_shelter, the on-camera adoption in the real popup, was inserted between s2 and s3. Existing shot and beat ids were kept so the eval and the beads need no renames; edit positions are now s1 1, s2 2, s2b 3, s3 4, s4 5. The new beats are b3c_shelter, b3d_pick and b3e_add.

capture.method: CDP Page.startScreencast, format png, everyNthFrame 1, every frame acked
capture.launch: chromium.launchPersistentContext(freshUserDataDir, { channel: 'chromium', headless: true, args: ['--disable-extensions-except=<recording dist>', '--load-extension=<recording dist>', '--force-device-scale-factor=2'], viewport: { width: 960, height: 436 }, deviceScaleFactor: 2 })
capture.rate: about 59 fps, variable, each frame carrying its own timestamp
capture.assembly: ffmpeg concat demuxer with per-frame durations to constant 25 fps; lossless or crf 12 or better intermediate
capture.not_used: Playwright recordVideo (VP8 halos; at pixel ratio 1 the dog is drawn at 0.46-0.56x of his GIF)

chrome.png: set/chrome/<page>.png per shot (the shot's page id); the 9:16 uses set/chrome/<page>-narrow.png
chrome.layers: a drawn Mac window and dark browser chrome at 2x: tab strip 40, toolbar 38 and bookmarks bar 26 CSS px; traffic lights top left, generic tabs, the address bar showing pixelpets.demo/<page>.html, and the Pixel Pets icon pinned in the toolbar. No logos.
chrome.pinned_icon_note: From the chrome geometry: the toolbar has 8 px side padding and 4 px gaps, and from its right edge holds the menu (24), the avatar (22 + 5 + 5), a separator (1 + 4 + 4), the extensions button (28) and the 16 px icon (6 px margins), so the icon spans CSS x 821-837 in the 960 px window and x 401-417 in the 540 px one, y 51-67.

stage.note: The chrome PNG fills stage y 0-208 and the 960x436 page capture sits 1:1 below it (stage y = 208 + 2 x CSS y). There is no floor band: pets stand on the frame bottom at every zoom.

master.length_rule: Under 27.3 s: extend the final hold by up to 1.0 s. Over 30.0 s: re-run s2_review with the next passing seed that catches within 1300 ms of the dblclick.
master.length_note: Nominal beats: beat 1 loses b1b's 1.20 s (the hook hold is 2600 ms, was 3800), so beats 1-3 run 0-11.13 s; adoption 2.89 s, greet 3.10 s, night 4.26 s, brand line 2.00 s, CTA hold 4.40 s = 27.78 s. The 436 px page shortens the ball's fall, so the catch timing is re-measured with the new seeds.

motion.direction: punchy motion graphics video. Keep it clean, polished; you are an incredible motion designer.
motion.pushes: Every short push is 450 ms (was 600) with an ease-out-expo curve, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). The night push stays a 3000 ms ease-in-out: the film's one slow move.
motion.captions: The pill springs in at FULL opacity (scale only: 0.9 to 1.0, at most 4% overshoot, 180 ms; only the words fade, so the olive border is whole from the pill's first frame); words keep the 70 ms stagger (opacity plus a 6 px rise); exit is a 120 ms fade.
motion.cuts: Hard cuts on an action frame only. No crossfades, wipes, whip pans or zoom blur.
motion.popup_card: overlays.popup_card: the only motion-graphic container in the film.
motion.brand_line: Rises 8 px and fades in over 300 ms, then holds still.
motion.cta: The icon pops (scale 0 to 1.06 to 1.0 over 240 ms), then each line rises 8 px and fades in, 90 ms apart, then everything holds still.
motion.never: No motion or effect is ever drawn on a page sprite. No HUD, level tags, confetti, glow, grain, vignette or dim layer. The product's own particles are the only effects on a page. The one dimmed image is the s2b backdrop still (overlays.popup_card.backdrop), never a live page.

conventions.units: CSS px in the 960x436 recording viewport, origin top-left. A pet's x is its sprite box's left edge (DRAW_W 64), so its centre is x + 32. Boxes sit at y 372-436 (innerHeight - 64). The content script ignores the stored y; write 372.
conventions.seed_fields: Written from the service worker before goto: roster -> pixel-pets-v1 {roster}; a roster pet with hidden true is constructed (one random draw for its spawn timer) but never drawn or updated. positions -> pixel-pets-positions-v1 (add y 372); treats and theme -> pixel-pets-settings-v1 {theme, treats, treatsUpdatedAt: now, homeAnchorAt: now - homeAnchorDaysAgo * 86400000}; visible -> pixel-pets-visible. Close the previous page before seeding, because its debounced position save can overwrite the new seed.
conventions.routed_html: Every set page is served through page.route at https://pixelpets.demo/<id>.html with the take's values templated into its root element: <html data-pp-seed='<seed>' data-pp-hour='<hour>'>. The content script runs at document_idle, so both attributes exist when the shim reads them.
conventions.shim: Recording copy of dist only; the shipped dist is never touched. content.js is prefixed with the proven shim: seeded mulberry32 Math.random plus Date.prototype.getHours. v3: at boot it reads the seed once from document.documentElement.dataset.ppSeed and writes data-pp-shim='v3;seed=<n>', or data-pp-shim='NO_SEED' when the attribute is missing. getHours reads dataset.ppHour on every call (default 14). The night flip is page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ppHour = '22'). v2 set the attributes with addInitScript before <html> existed, so every v2 run was really seed 0.
conventions.prng: prng.seed null means search: run the shot headless with the sim candidates first, then seeds 1, 2, 3 and so on, and keep the first seed whose run satisfies every accept rule. prng.prefer ranks passing seeds. Each 9:16 re-record runs its own search. sim_pass_rate is the pass rate of a port of the real state machine over 2000 seeds (it matched the browser to within 1-3 frames on six seeds); it is guidance, not a result.
conventions.hover_point: The live img box's upper-right corner, 5 px inside: (box.right - 5, box.top + 5). Re-read the box before every mouse step and re-aim until the swipe src is observed. The whole img box is the hit target. At this point the drawn arrow covers none of Rex's art pixels, facing either way.
conventions.action_kinds_note: assert_shim reads data-pp-shim and discards the take unless it is 'v3;seed=<the shot seed>'. It runs right after pets_ready and before any other action. set_hour sets document.documentElement.dataset.ppHour in the page, and the shim reads it on its next getHours call. Popup kinds (s2b only): open_popup opens chrome-extension://<id>/popup/popup.html in a new page; wait_popup_ready waits for popup_ready; glide_to moves the mouse to a selector's live centre, or to the action's `at` point when one is given ({from: 'left', dx, dy: 'middle'}: dx CSS px right of the live left edge, vertically centred); click_at clicks there and logs the named event; type_text types with a fixed key delay; press sends mousedown, logs its event, and mouseup release_after_ms later.

states.pets_ready: every visible roster pet has an img in #pixel-pets-host's shadow root
states.idle|walk|run|swipe|lie: that pet's img src matches assets/<type>/<color>_<gif>_8fps.gif
states.greet_start: two pets switch to swipe on the same frame with neither hovered
states.ball_on: the yellow-green #b5d92a disc is first found in the canvas scan (g > 170, b < 100, g > r + 15)
states.ball_floor: the ball's logged y reaches a local maximum (floor contact)
states.ball_off: the disc is no longer found
states.heart_on: red heart pixels are first found in the canvas scan (r > 180, g < 70, b < 90); log the red-pixel centroid x and y. The threshold is tuned for Apple Color Emoji.
states.catch: ball_off and heart_on arrive within 60 ms of each other; the catcher is the visible pet whose box centre x is nearest heart.x; it counts only if abs(heart.x - (box.x + 32)) <= 40 and box.top - 48 <= heart.y <= box.top. Never measure from the box centre, and never infer a catch from run turning to idle (nearBall flickers).
states.sleep: the first frame on which every visible pet shows the lie sprite
states.popup_ready: two .pet-item rows rendered, 14 .type-cell buttons built and Nunito loaded in the popup page
states.roster_saved: chrome.storage.onChanged reports pixel-pets-v1 with the adopted pet

conventions.events: The recorder writes events.json with epoch ms for: clap (start and end of every page capture), first_paint, pets_ready, shim (the data-pp-shim value), src (pet, from, to), greet_start, greet_end, ball_on, ball_floor, ball_off, heart_on (x, y), catch, hour_set, sleep, cursor samples (about 60 Hz, per page), and mousedown, mouseup, click and dblclick with their x and y. In s2b_shelter: popup_ready, shelter_click, name_click, type_selected (type), color_selected (color), add_mousedown, add_mouseup, roster_saved, plus per-frame DOMRects of every .type-cell (by data-type) and of the six named elements #pets-list, #btn-add-toggle, #add-pet-form, #pet-name, #pet-color-label and #btn-add. Every popup click event (shelter_click, name_click, type_selected, color_selected) and add_mousedown carries the CSS point it was sent at (x, y).
conventions.tracks: In the same rAF loop as the canvas scan (about 1.8 ms a scan), log every visible pet's box {t, id, x, y, w, h, src} and the ball's centre {t, x, y} on every frame. The camera follows walking pets from this track, and the compositor checks margins against it.
conventions.edit_anchors: cursor_depart is the start of s1's first glide. ball_in_frame is the first frame the ball's disc is inside the current crop (at 1.0x the whole viewport is on screen, so it is the ball_on frame; at 2.0x it is the frame the ball passes page CSS y 166). catch_point is the logged ball x at the catch.
conventions.anchors: <event>[:<pet>][+ms|-ms], for example pets_ready+240, src:rex:swipe, mouseup:rex, catch+2000. Every in, out, caption, camera move and sfx time is an anchor. No beat cuts on a fixed clock time. mouse:<mousedown|mouseup|click|dblclick>[+ms|-ms] resolves to the first observed event of that kind, whatever the pet (for example mouse:dblclick+90). Edit-only anchors, resolved by the edit, not the recorder: in, end, cursor_depart, ball_in_frame, catch_point.

camera.crop: At zoom z the crop is 1920/z by 1080/z stage px with its bottom edge on the frame bottom (stage y 1080), so the pets' feet stay on the frame bottom at every zoom. At 2.0x the crop is 960x540 at stage y 540-1080, which shows page CSS y 166-436 and no chrome. Horizontally it centres on the focus and clamps to the stage edges.
camera.focus: page = the whole stage; pet:<id> = centred on that pet, following the box track with 400 ms smoothing; between:<a>,<b> = centred between two pets; catch_point = centred on the logged catch x.
checks: Fail the render if a crop edge comes within 16 stage px (8 CSS px) of a visible pet box on any frame, unless that edge is the page edge.

Fail the render if any caption, name tag, clock, brand line or CTA comes within 80 output px of a pet box, or inside the particle column (the box's x range widened by 24 CSS px, extended 80 CSS px up) of a pet that can emit particles in that span: from a hover, feed or catch until its particles fade. Sleeping pets emit none, so the s4 brand line and CTA may sit above them.
s2_review push: if the ball leaves the crop between ball_in_frame and the catch, or Rex breaks the margin, fall back to a 1.0x hold and a hard cut to 2.0x on the catch frame.
s2b_shelter: fail the render if any shown frame of the popup take is not exactly one declared crop, or if a crop meets a forbidden cell's DOMRect on that frame.
camera.sample: camera.sample is the zoom of the steady hold that a beat's master_t samples (1.0 or 2.0). b1a_open, b3a_throw, b4a_hi and b5_lights_out sample a 1.0x hold (their 2.0x push is short or has not finished); every other beat samples a 2.0x hold. The edit puts master_t in the middle of that hold and the eval classifies beats by it. New in the adoption pass: 'card' marks the s2b popup beats (b3c_shelter, b3d_pick, b3e_add). They show no live page (their backdrop is a still), so SSIM, margin and aim do not apply; they are checked by crop disjointness from the forbidden cells and by caption presence at caption_at.

conventions.cursor: Never recorded. Drawn in Remotion from the logged path: a black arrow with a 2 px white outline, 22 CSS px tall, in page space, so it scales with the camera. A click on the page draws one ring (250 ms, up to 18 CSS px radius) stroked #484848 with a 1 px cream inner stroke; a double-click draws two rings 90 ms apart. A click inside a pet box draws no ring. cursor_start.visible false keeps the cursor hidden until its first move.
conventions.captions: VT323 72 px, lowercase, #484848 on a cream #FFE3B0 pill with a 3 px olive #A4B859 border, 6 px radius, 12/22 px padding, at most 30 characters. One caption on screen at a time, and the name tag counts as a caption; the clock, the brand line and the CTA are separate layers. Placed in the band above the pet strip, beside the acting pet, at least 80 output px from its box and outside the particle column of any pet that can emit particles in that span (from a hover, feed or catch until they fade); when it does not fit beside, above that column with the same gap. Never a fixed corner.
conventions.clapperboard: The recorder shows a 160 ms full-viewport magenta frame (inline all:initial; opacity:1) at the start and end of every page capture, and the edit trims it. Alignment is measured from the release edge of both clappers; never assume a start lag.
conventions.retry: A take that fails accept is discarded and re-run with the next seed. Nothing is patched, re-clicked or faked in the edit.

page_rules: Fonts are bundled OFL files served through the same page.route (Inter, Source Serif 4, JetBrains Mono) with no system fallback; before the first action the recorder checks that each family has a FontFace in document.fonts with status 'loaded' (document.fonts.check() is true even for an undeclared family, so it is never the test).
Wide layout: the whole 960x436 viewport is on screen at 1.0x, under the drawn chrome; no strip of the page is hidden.
Wide layout: the top edge of a 2.0x hold is page CSS y 166 (stage y 540); no text box straddles y 166.
Bottom 150 CSS px (y 286-436): no text and nothing interactive for the pets to stand on. The one exception is div#dbl-zone on the review page, the transparent, empty double-click target.

Narrow layout (540x856, for the 9:16): the whole viewport is on screen under the chrome; the 2.0x crop (540x960 output px at stage y 960) begins at page CSS y 376, so no text box straddles y 376; the bottom 150 px (y 706-856) follows the rule above.

accept: data-pp-shim reads 'v3;seed=<seed>' before the first action
Rex's first transition is walkLeft, 2000-2600 ms after pets_ready
Rex's box stays inside CSS x 8-952, and Rex never shows the lie sprite before out

actions.note: In point reference. The edit starts 160 ms earlier, on the empty inbox.
The hook. The caption lands at +240 and the name tag at +2140. Rex starts walking left between +2000 and +2600 (accept).
From the top right to 130 px above Rex's live hover point, re-reading his box each step because he is walking. This departure is the edit anchor cursor_depart.
Drop onto the hover point, re-reading the live box each step.
mouseenter fired: swipe plus one 👋. The state machine is frozen while hovered.
Lets the 👋 fade before the treat. Costs no determinism, because hover freezes the state machine.
mousedown and mouseup 60 ms apart at the hover point. Never click twice.
Leave within 100 ms of the mouseup, up and to the right, so the eat state shows the idle sprite under 🍖 and ❤️.
Measured from the mouseup. On timeout, discard the take and run it again.
Covers the out point (heart_on+1900), then close the page.

seed.note: homeAnchorDaysAgo 9 gives capacity min(7, 1 + floor(9/3)) = 4 homes (src/settings.ts:16-17, 62-70), so the gate (src/popup/capacity-gate.ts canAddPet) allows a third pet.

shots.open: In the same persistent context: page.goto('chrome-extension://<extension id>/popup/popup.html'), the id taken from the service worker URL. The recording copy of dist is used, but the shim touches only content.js, so this is the shipped popup.

layout_expect.columns_why: body is border-box with 20 px padding (popup.css:1-5, 79-85) and the form has 16 px padding (popup.css:380-388), so at 500 CSS px the type grid is 428 px wide; repeat(auto-fill, minmax(64px, 1fr)) with a 6 px gap (popup.css:442-446) gives 6 columns of about 66.3 px. Rows: chicken crab dog fox miffy monkey / panda snail totoro turtle cockatiel rat / snake horse. 500 px is the width where chicken and panda share column 1 with only crab and snail beside them: at 420 px (5 columns) the monkey sits under the chicken, and at 560 px or wider the totoro or cockatiel sits under the chicken or crab.
layout_expect.no_scroll: document.scrollingElement.scrollHeight <= innerHeight with the form expanded; otherwise discard the take (a scroll would move cells between crops). Measured on the shipped popup (da09dab, Playwright 1.63 headless, DPR 2, Nunito loaded, this seed): at 500x760 the expanded page is 936 px tall and Add Pet sits at CSS y 810-849, below the fold; at 500x960 scrollHeight = innerHeight = 960 and every control is on screen, so the take is 500x960 (native 1000x1920).
layout_expect.banner: Opened as a tab, the popup's active-tab probe (popup.ts init) finds no content script on its own tab, so #special-page-banner shows and the ball button is disabled. Both sit above crop A and are never in frame.

The new pet's id is crypto.randomUUID() (popup.ts:241).

crops.rule: Rects are computed per frame from the DOMRects the recorder logs, never hard-coded. Every frame the edit shows from this take is exactly one of these crops, and each crop must be disjoint from every forbidden cell's logged DOMRect on that frame, or the render fails. The eval recomputes each frame's crop from the logged DOMRects by these rules (native px = CSS x 2, each edge rounded) and requires the declared rect to equal it within 1 native px.
crops.layout_shift_trap: addPet() (src/popup/popup.ts:227-265) re-renders the pet list one row taller before it collapses the form, which pushes the type grid down into crop C for up to about 250 ms. Crop C therefore ends 160 ms after the Add Pet mousedown and the mouseup is sent at +240 (the click, and addPet, fire on mouseup): the press is on screen for 2-3 frames, the layout shift never is.

popup_card.backdrop: a still: the review chrome (set/chrome/review.png, or review-narrow.png in the 9:16) undimmed at stage y 0-208, over the last shown s2_review source frame at 1.0x (the page capture at stage y 208 and down) multiplied by 0.45. The chrome stays on screen during s2b so the card hangs from its pinned icon.
popup_card.card: exactly one declared crop of the popup take (s2b_shelter.crops), at an integer scale of the native frame (A and C 1x, B 2x), nearest-neighbour, placed per placement below; 12 px corner mask and a soft shadow (0 12px 32px rgba(72,72,72,0.18)). Nothing is drawn over the crop's pixels except the cursor and its click rings.
popup_card.in: pops in: a scale spring from 0.94 to 1.0 and y +24 px to 0 over 200 ms, at FULL opacity (no fade: every frame shows only the declared crop's pixels)
popup_card.between: the card frame morphs to the next crop's output size with a 160 ms spring about the same placement anchor; the content hard-cuts to the next crop at the morph start and is that crop scaled UNIFORMLY (one factor for x and y, the largest that fits inside the frame's current size, nearest-neighbour when the factor is an integer), centred in the frame, with the rest of the frame in the popup's own cream #FFE3B0. The declared frames[].at/w/h is that content box, so w/rect.w equals h/rect.h. It is never a mask over a wider region of the popup, never panned, never stretched, and never shows popup outside the declared crop.
popup_card.out: none: a hard cut to s3_sheet's first_paint at b3e out
popup_card.cursor: the same arrow, in popup CSS space, scaled with the card (22 CSS px x 2 native x card scale); a click on a control draws the usual ring. The cursor and its rings are clipped to the card's current rect: they are never drawn on the backdrop or past the canvas. Every click is aimed inside the crop on screen (s2b_shelter.actions), so the tip is on the card at every click; during a glide that starts outside the next crop the clipped arrow is off the card for 2-3 frames, which is expected.
popup_card.caption: one caption for b3c-b3e, a fixed screen-space layer inside placement.<aspect>.caption_rect (it never moves with the morph), at least 40 px from every card size

placement.frames: the timeline declares the card on EVERY master frame of b3c-b3e (card.frames[]: {t, rect, at, w, h}; rect in native popup px by the crop rule, at and w x h the content box in output px, integers, w/rect.w = h/rect.h), spring and morph frames included; the eval judges every one
placement.anchor_rule: at steady state (outside the 200 ms pop-in and the 160 ms morphs) the card's top-left is exactly steady_at.<aspect>.<crop>: x = min(anchor.icon_cx, frame width - anchor.margin_x - card width), y = min(anchor.top, frame height - card height), even integers. The card always overlaps the icon's x and hangs from the toolbar; the integer scales and morph rules are unchanged.

steady_at.note: The exact top-left output px of each steady card: the anchor rule's position rounded to EVEN integers (a yuv420p master keeps a card on even pixels aligned with its 2x2 chroma blocks: round 7 measured B at (325,73) 0.918 SSIM against 0.994 at (324,72)). The composition renders these exact integers; every frame after the pop-in or morph uses them.
